bibl.title: Nalacaritram
bibl.note: Sastri, Shyamdas, and Mishra, Ramapati (eds.). Nalacaritram [Nala] of Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. Varanasi: Caukhambha Samskrrita Samsthana, 1987.

Āccādīkṣita, Nīlakaṇṭha's brother, and is mentioned in the prologue as the author of a commentary on the play. Whether such a commentary was actually composed cannot be determined, as it does not survive.
Samarapuṅgayajvan is referenced; Nīlakaṇṭha quotes him in the prologue of the play (V. 6-8).
